parsedReview.oneParagraphVerdict: The chapter teaches a strong, memorable core move: isolate the miss, stretch slightly, get immediate feedback, and change the next attempt. It is beginner-friendly, practical, and honest about limits, with good cross-domain transfer. The major blocker is the source-contradictory instruction in Example 1, which tells readers to do the opposite of the lesson. Fix that and tighten the ambiguous/tell-heavy quiz items, and this would be close to shippable.
